verdict.rationale: Nix ships its own distinct command set (nix-env, nix-shell, nix develop, nix build) with no evidence of aliasing, compatibility shims, or documentation mapping to incumbent package-manager commands (apt/brew/npm) for switchers. Community comments even highlight a steep learning curve and unfamiliar workflow ('You have to dig deep to fix errors', 'cost of wrapping packages is just a little too high') rather than familiar conventions being preserved.
